        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_inspect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_forward_acc</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_resolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_merge_clar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_resend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_forward_commercial</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_resolve_complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_file_sig</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E_end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="S_start" name="Invoice received on paper or by fax" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_receive" name="Receive invoice in central inbox" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_inspect" name="Inspect invoice visually" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_forward_acc" name="Forward invoice to accounting employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_identify" name="Identify charging suppliers" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_create" name="Create new invoice instance in ACME Financial Accounting" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_check_items" name="Check invoice items" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_note_docket" name="Note cost center and cost center managers for each position on docket" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_send_first" name="Send docket and copy of invoice to first cost center manager" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_merge_review" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_review" name="Review invoice items for accuracy" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_ok" name="Everything in order?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_mark_ap" name="Mark position AP on docket" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_reject" name="Reject AP with note and explanatory statement on docket" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_clarify" name="Clarify inconsistencies with vendor" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_consult" name="Consult cost center managers again?" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_merge_consult" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_resolved" name="All inconsistencies resolved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_resend" name="Send copy of invoice to cost center managers again" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_forward_commercial" name="Forward copy of invoice to commercial manager" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_merge_audit" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_audit" name="Perform commercial audit" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_complaint" name="Complaint during commercial audit?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_resolve_complaint" name="Resolve complaint with supplier" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_approve" name="Issue approval for payment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_amount" name="Bill amount exceeds EUR 20?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_board" name="Check invoice again (four-eyes principle)" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_merge_amt" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_file_sig" name="Return copy of invoice and docket to accounting in signature file" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_pay_instr" name="Give payment instructions" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_close" name="Close instance in ACME Financial Accounting" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E_end" name="Invoice processed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F02" sourceRef="T_receive" targetRef="T_inspect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F03" sourceRef="T_inspect" targetRef="T_forward_acc" />
